verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner structure with a clear headline and subhead, but the CTA comes before the headline, the SOLSTICE logo is gone, the can is tiny, and the NEW FLAVOR badge overlaps the can and is cropped at the bottom edge. B breaks the headline onto two cramped lines, squeezes the subhead into a narrow four-line column that runs into the badge and is cut off at the right edge, and scatters a tiny product and stray sun fragments across empty orange space, with no logo and no clear hierarchy.
